unreadDesc.zh: 在会话菜单标记未读，切走后再次打开时清除；标记保存到当前配置，自动完成提醒保持独立。
unreadDesc.en: Mark sessions unread from their menu. Marks survive reloads and clear on a later visit; automatic completion reminders stay independent.

saveFailed.zh: 未读标记未能保存，请稍后重试。
saveFailed.en: Could not save the unread mark. Please try again.
